method: Each pair of points lies on the two indicated faces of the installed model, in millimetres. The signed axis looks from the printed face toward the mating surface. The difference along it is the clearance at the marked section in the nominal assembly pose. A negative value is interference.

sections.title: Water regulator saddle
sections.note: The accepted cap raises the saddle 0.40 mm toward the regulator. At the marked section the nominal faces overlap. With the hardware seated against both bearings, the hooks still engage 1.53 mm per side.

sections.title: Pisco regulator cradle
sections.note: The accepted full-size cover raises this cradle 0.20 mm. The separate rigid outlet lip advances 0.24 mm and the forward wing stop advances 0.12 mm.

sections.title: Flow meter saddle
sections.note: The production cover sets the saddle back 0.40 mm from its earlier position. The separate upper guide on the receiver has 0.25 mm of relief for its supported face.

sections.title: Backflow preventer vent window
sections.note: The window passes over the protruding vent as the cover closes. Its side wall uses the ordinary sliding allowance. Derek accepted the full-size assembly.

sections.title: Pump motor seat
sections.dimension: Gap at the nominal motor crown
sections.note: The production saddle reaches 0.40 mm farther toward the motor. The model shows the nominal pump position. When the motor rests on the fixed rails, the full-solid study gives 0.36 mm to the cover.

sections.title: Display cover retaining lips
sections.note: Both lips reach 1.20 mm into their grooves. The relaxed cover wall springs inward 1.25 mm at the lip top. Once seated, each lip contacts the root and has 0.30 mm at either end.
